findings.evidence: The item names the “usual” chart seminorms and LF limit but does not specify the fixed-support seminorms for density sections, the inductive-limit topology, or the local representative u_x. Its test-topology dependency covers scalar test functions on Euclidean open sets, not densities on arbitrary manifolds. A Definition repair would affect consumers in other current-run batches, so I left the carrier unchanged.

The claim is for any smooth manifold, but its global WF dependency is defined only after assuming an oriented, time-oriented, globally hyperbolic Lorentzian manifold of dimension n≥2. This item has no Lorentzian hypothesis. Supply a general global wavefront definition or make the stated scope consistent.

Supply a general-dimensional proof or an exact theorem with matching hypotheses.
